result.rationale: The diff shows `const isTeamAdminOrOwner = (await isTeamAdmin(user.id, booking.eventType?.teamId ?? 0)) && (await isTeamOwner(user.id, booking.eventType?.teamId ?? 0));` — an AND of two mutually exclusive role checks where the variable name and intended semantics clearly call for an OR. A membership carries a single role, so this conjunction is false for any team admin or owner, causing the subsequent FORBIDDEN check to reject them for team bookings.

judged_text: The team-permission check ANDs isTeamAdmin and isTeamOwner, requiring a user to hold both roles at once - impossible for a membership that carries a single role - so isTeamAdminOrOwner is false for every team admin. A team admin (and, if isTeamAdmin matches only the ADMIN role, the owner too) who picks 'Additional Guests' on a team booking gets a 403 you_do_not_have_permission; the admin-or-owner access this branch was named to grant never works.
